description: This file contains extension helpers for the CanvasWindowController class, providing utility functions for session key sanitization, JavaScript string literal encoding, frame persistence, and restoration.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string by trimming whitespace and replacing disallowed characters with underscores.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a string as a JSON string literal, escaping characters as needed.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON string literal for a given optional string, or 'null' if nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a key for storing frame information in UserDefaults based on sanitized session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Loads a window frame (NSRect) from UserDefaults, returning nil if not found or invalid.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores a window frame (NSRect) in UserDefaults under a key derived from the session key.
